# Picked

> Picked is a US whey protein drink mix flavored mainly with real freeze-dried fruit. It is in development and not yet for sale. The first flavor is Strawberry; Mango and Raspberry Lemon are being voted on by the waitlist.

- Planned: 20g whey protein isolate per scoop, sweetened with monk fruit and/or stevia, no sucralose.
- Grams of real fruit per scoop will be printed on the pack once the formula is final.
- Every lot will be tested for heavy metals, with results linked by QR code.
- Planned price: $54.99 for 20 servings.

## Pages

- [Home and waitlist](https://pickedprotein.com/): what Picked is and how to join the waitlist
- [The Lot Book](https://pickedprotein.com/lots/): lab results for every lot, once production starts
- [The Real Fruit Test](https://pickedprotein.com/real-fruit-test/): how to read a protein label for real fruit, sweeteners, protein %DV, and lab results
